# Mech Assemble Wiki

> A community database for the mobile game Mech Assemble: Zombie Swarm. Look up any mech and see its skills, skill upgrade tree, unique weapon, accessory, skins, helpers, pilots, and awakening progression.

This is a read-only reference site. Game data is entered by an admin; visitors browse it. There are no user accounts on the public pages.

## Main pages

- [All Mechs](https://mech-assemble-wiki.online/): Browse every mech in the game; each links to a detail page with skills, weapon, accessory, pilot, skins, and awakening.
- [Weapons](https://mech-assemble-wiki.online/weapons): Unique weapons, their stats, upgrades, and skins.
- [Accessories](https://mech-assemble-wiki.online/accessories): Accessories and their exclusive effects.
- [Pilots](https://mech-assemble-wiki.online/pilots): Pilots and the bonuses they grant.

## Optional

- [Full page sitemap](https://mech-assemble-wiki.online/api/sitemap.xml): Machine-readable list of every mech and weapon page, generated from the live database.
